datum: I will take the cup of salvation; * and call upon the Name of the Lord.
in-tempore-paschali: I will take the cup of salvation; * and call upon the Name of the Lord.

datum: With them * that hated peace I was peaceable: when I spoke to them they fought against me without cause.
in-tempore-paschali: With them * that hated peace I was peaceable: when I spoke to them they fought against me without cause.

datum: From unjust men * deliver me, O Lord.
Keep me * from the snare, which they have laid for me, and from the stumbling-blocks of them that work iniquity.
in-tempore-paschali: Keep me * from the snare, which they have laid for me, and from the stumbling-blocks of them that work iniquity.

datum: I looked * on my right hand, and beheld, and there was no one that would know me.
in-tempore-paschali: I looked * on my right hand, and beheld, and there was no one that would know me.

datum: They part my garments among them, * and cast lots upon my vesture.
Strangers are risen up against me, * and oppressors seek after my soul.
When He had received the vinegar, * he said: It is finished! and he bowed his Head, and gave up the Ghost.
in-tempore-paschali: When He had received the vinegar, * he said: It is finished! and he bowed his Head, and gave up the Ghost.
